# pi-glance 0.7.3

- Respect Pi's public theme appearance when selecting Glance's light/dark palette, including system and custom themes. Older Pi versions retain the exact theme-name fallback.
- Include persisted boundary compaction and branch-summary usage without requiring a reload. Deduplicate event and entry accounting across startup, tree reconciliation and reload.
- Refresh authoritative Context at final settlement, including unknown values after compaction. Context edits do not remove historical charges, and nested-tool usage remains counted once.
- Keep Context limits independent of model-selection metadata, so changing a virtual model's thinking level cannot overwrite the physical responding model's context capacity.
- Expand CI to Pi 0.86.1 and 1.0.0 on Node 22 and 24, with SDK version verification and isolated agent directories.
- No settings-panel redesign, configuration migration, new runtime dependencies or minimum-version increase. Requires Pi 0.86.1+ and Node.js 22.19.0+.
